feeds.title: Fr. Z's Blog
feeds.description: Fr. Z's Blog brings you clear, straight commentary on Catholic issues, liturgy and life. Fr. John Zuhlsdorfo tries to point his discussions back to what it is to be Catholic in this increasingly difficult age, to love God, and how to get to heaven.

feeds.title: Vultus Christi
feeds.description: Vultus Christi is the blog of Dom Mark Daniel Kirby, Vultus Christ explores the ecclesial mandate of his Benedictine community.

feeds.title: A Concord Pastor Comments
feeds.description: A Concord Pastor is a blog by Austin Fleming, a priest in the Archdiocese of Boston, writes about spirituality, worship, and prayer in the Roman Catholic Tradition.

feeds.title: Father Bob's Reflections
feeds.description: Father Bob helps his readers connect with God, the self, and the Word with the help of his blog Father Bobs Reflections.

feeds.title: Cardinal Seán's Blog
feeds.description: Cardinal Seán Patrick Cardinal O'Malley, OFM Cap is the ninth bishop and sixth archbishop in the more than 200-year history of the Archdiocese of Boston. On this blog, Cardinal Seán O'Malley shares his reflections & experiences.

feeds.title: Bangor to Bobbio
feeds.description: Since we are travellers and pilgrims in the world, let us ever ponder on the end of the road, that is of our life, for the end of our roadway is our home (St Columban, 8th sermon). This is a personal blog by Fr Seán Coyle, a Catholic priest, member of the Missionary Society of St Columban, from Dublin, Ireland.

feeds.title: Paulist Fathers Blog
feeds.description: The Paulist Fathers' blog is a conversation on various topics like Love, Heart, the Church, and many more. We are a missionary society of Catholic priests, we share the Good News of Jesus through missions, media, campus ministries, parishes, downtown centers, and more.

feeds.title: Pilgrim Priest
feeds.description: Theology from a wandering priest is a blog by Fr. David Nix. He is a Roman Catholic priest who was raised in the city of Denver. Fr. David was ordained in 2010 and is now a diocesan hermit who is fighting for the end of abortion and child-trafficking.

feeds.title: Domine, da mihi hanc aquam!
feeds.description: Dominican friar's homilies from New Orleans. Social-political commentary from a Catholic priest.

feeds.title: Fr. Dwight Longenecker Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Standing on My Head! Find the newest blog posts as well as fourteen years work of archived blogging content by Fr. Longenecker. He is a Pastor of Our Lady of the Rosary Church in Greenville. Fr. Longenecker stated this website as a simple blog back in 2006 and it has grown to become a center for all his ministries, both online and in person.

feeds.title: Bonfire of the Vanities
feeds.description: I am the parish priest at Saint Remy Parish in Russia, Ohio, in the Archdiocese of Cincinnati. Follow to get updates from this blog.

feeds.title: Association Of Catholic Priests Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Priests who wish to have a forum, and a voice to reflect, discuss, and comment on issues affecting the Irish Church and society today. Visit their blog to learn about the Liturgy, other useful resources, events, articles, services, and more.

feeds.title: City Father
feeds.description: Rev. Ronald Franco, a member of the Paulist Fathers, writes about world events, political happenings, and Church news.

feeds.title: Servant and Steward
feeds.description: Servant and Steward is my personal web log. I am a priest of the Diocese of Springfield in Illinois and currently pursuing a licentiate in canon law (J.C.L.) at the Pontifical Gregorian University in Rome.Here you will find my homilies, thoughts, and many other things of interest to me; I hope they will also be of interest to you.

feeds.title: friarmusings
feeds.description: Read the musings of a Franciscan Friar. My name is Fr. George Corrigan and I am a Franciscan Friar, a Catholic priest, a son, a brother to my sisters, an uncle and a great-uncle, and a friend. I try to live the words of St. Francis of Assisi: 'Therefore hold back nothing of yourselves for yourselves, so that He who gives himself totally to you may receive you totally.'

feeds.title: Offerimus Tibi Domine
feeds.description: Offerimus Tibi Domine is a blog by Fr. Simon Henry who blogs about the priesthood.

feeds.title: Father Jason Worthley
feeds.description: Fr. Jason Worthley was ordained to the priesthood in 2004. Find Homilies and other posts by Father Jason Worthley.

feeds.title: Fr Hunwicke's Mutual Enrichment
feeds.description: Fr Hunwicke's Mutual Enrichment is a blog by Father John Hunwicke. For nearly three decades he taught Latin and Greek language and literature, was Head of Theology, and Assistant Chaplain at Lancing College.

feeds.title: Meeting Christ in the Liturgy
feeds.description: Fr. Kevin Cusick, author of a weekly column for The Wanderer, the oldest US Catholic weekly, also writes this informative blog about lessons learned from the Bible.

feeds.title: Fr. Joe Laramie, S.J. Blog
feeds.description: Online reflections on spirituality, life, Gospels, and more by Father Joe Laramie that have appeared on The Jesuit Post and America Magazine. He is the national director of the Pope's Worldwide Prayer Network and is also a National Eucharistic Preacher for the USCCB Eucharistic Revival.

feeds.title: Posts by Father Gordon MacRae — Beyond These Stone Walls
feeds.description: These Stone Walls is a blog of a Catholic priest in extraordinary circumstances. There are few authentic prophetic voices among us, guiding truth-seekers along the right path. Among them is Fr. Gordon MacRae, mighty voice in the prison tradition of John the Baptist, Maximilian Kolbe, Alfred Delp, SJ, and Dietrich Bonhoffer.

feeds.title: Fr. Ed Broom, OMV Blog
feeds.description: Fr Ed's teaches Catholic Ignatian Marian Spirituality through articles, podcasts, a radio show, retreats and spiritual direction. Father Ed Broom, OMV, is Associate Pastor of St. Peter Chanel Church. He is a member of the Oblates of the Virgin Mary and was ordained by Blessed John Paul II on May 25, 1986.

feeds.title: Fr. Healey's Blog
feeds.description: Father Healey writes about various topics and current affairs related to the Catholic Church in his blog. He was appointed the seventeenth Pastor of Our Lady of Mercy Church in East Greenwich in June 2012 by Bishop Thomas J. Tobin.

feeds.title: Fr. Burke Masters
feeds.description: Fr. Burke Masters is the Baseball Priest. When Fr. Burke attended Providence Catholic High School for his dream of becoming a Major League baseball player, he fell in love with the Eucharist and the Catholic Church. In June of 2006 he became the Vocation Director for the Diocese of Joliet and now travels around the diocese to encourage the youth to lay down their lives for the sake of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: A Jesuit's Jottings
feeds.description: Rick Malloy, S.J., is a Jesuit priest and cultural anthropologist. He is the Vice President for Mission and Ministry, The University of Scranton.

feeds.title: Blogger Priest
feeds.description: Blogger Priest is a personal blog of Fr. Joseph Jenkins, Blogger Priest treats readers to topics on the priesthood. He writes that priests are ministers of reconciliation, but never at the cost of truth.

feeds.title: Father Ray's 'Other' Corner
feeds.description: Fr. Ray Suriani uses this blog to post his homilies, including a link to an audio recording. He touches on justice, reparation, and resurrection.

feeds.title: Father Matt's Sonshine
feeds.description: Fr. Matt is focused on helping others by showing them their potential and not their thorns. He has provided pastoral care and clinical services for over 40 years.

feeds.title: Living Sacrifice
feeds.description: Fr. Christopher Mahars blog is his way of connecting with his congregation and the wider world of those who seek spiritual teaching. Readers are able to find an archive of his homilies.

feeds.title: Catholic American Eyes in Korea
feeds.description: Catholic American Eyes in Korea is a group blog of the Maryknoll Priests, this blog explores the Catholic experience in Korea.

feeds.title: The Alternate Path
feeds.description: Fr. Michael Cummins reflects on following Christ and discerning ones vocation. He finds inspiration from Pope Benedict XVI.

feeds.title: Aisling on Earth
feeds.description: The mission of Fr. Joseph Hennessys blog is to bring home the fact that each one of us are spiritual beings having a human experience.

feeds.title: Homily on the Spot
feeds.description: Fr. Jim Chern has been a priest in the Archdiocese of Newark since 1999. On Homily on the Spot, Fr. Jim posts his homilies, messages on the love of Christ, and ways to live better lives.

feeds.title: Father Dennis
feeds.description: Hello, I am Father Dennis and I am a happy Catholic Priest seeking for Reverent Spirituality, Freedom in Christ, and the Love of Christ.

feeds.title: Father Talks Too Fast
feeds.description: Fr. Faulkner explains about Catholic teaching related to the Mass and the Bible. He is a Catholic Priest and a Teacher.

feeds.title: Annales Ecclesiae Ucrainae
feeds.description: Annales Ecclesiae Ucrainae is a collection of articles by Rev Dr Athanasius McVay, pertaining to the history of the Ukrainian Greek-Catholic Church. It is inspired by great works of ecclesiastical history. Rev Dr Athanasius McVay is a Priest and Church historian specializing in the history of the Holy See's diplomacy and of the Ukrainian Greek-Catholic Church in the XIX and XX centuries.

feeds.title: A Catholic Priest in Mississippi
feeds.description: Homilies, reflections, and photos from Father Lincoln, a Roman Catholic priest serving in the Diocese of Jackson in the state of Mississippi. Currently, he is the pastor of St Jude Catholic Church in Pearl in Rankin County, just outside the city of Jackson.

feeds.title: An Encouraging Word
feeds.description: An Encouraging Word is a blog that is encouraging, informing, connecting, and involving interested people in creative and unique ministry opportunities: what am I doing, what can you do, and what we can do together. Rev. J. Ronald Knott is a priest of the Archdiocese of Louisville, Kentucky and was ordained on May 16, 1970.

feeds.title: Eyes of Faith
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to add a place to conduct a conversation on the elusive nature or features of listening to and following God's will. It is concerned with the 'how and why' of seeing with Eyes of Faith. My name is Fr. Larry Gearhart and I'm a retired priest. My current duties include daily Mass, administering the sacraments and pastoral care.

feeds.title: Father Christopher Zugger
feeds.description: Read the blog posts by Father Christopher Zugger where he gives Glory to Jesus Christ. Father Christopher is a priest of the Catholic Church, ordained in 1981. He hears confessions, assists at Divine Liturgies, services and classes in the parish, under the direction of the pastor. He provides spiritual direction for laity and clergy.

feeds.title: Fr. Carmen Mele, O.P.: Today's Homilette
feeds.description: Fr. Carmen Mele's blog, Today's Homilette is a Reflection on Weekday Mass Readings. Fr. Carmen Mele is a Bilingual Catholic priest of the Southern Dominican Province.

feeds.title: Faithfulness and Love
feeds.description: Welcome! This blog contains daily and Sunday reflections for Weekday and Sunday Mass. I am Fr. Andrew Kooi and the title of the blog - Faithfulness and Love, is based on my ordination theme, where I was ordained a priest of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kuala Lumpur on 13 April 2008.

feeds.title: Catalytic Converter
feeds.description: Fr. Bedel writes about his views on various topics and posts about his visits to religious locations around the world in his blog. He is a priest of the Archdiocese of Cincinnati and expresses his opinions through his blog.

feeds.title: Father Anthony Ho
feeds.description: The Blog of a Chinese Catholic Priest, Father Anthony Ho, in Vancouver. He is a Pastor of St. John the Apostle Parish at Archdiocese of Vancouver.

feeds.title: A JESUIT'S BLOG
feeds.description: Read the Homilies and blog posts by Father Errol Fernandes SJ. He is a Jesuit Priest that is interested in Scripture and Spirituality and in making people aware that they can always be happy and on top of the world at every moment of every day.

feeds.title: Fr. Joseph Illo's Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Fr. Joseph Illo's blog. He completed his seminary training at St. Joseph's Seminary, New York in 1991. Fr. Illo is currently serving as pastor of Star of the Sea Parish in San Francisco. He prays that this site will serve to inspire your life in Christ.

feeds.title: From my side of the Altar
feeds.description: A Catholic Priest's Blog with Scripture, Saints, the Church and Contemporary issues. This blog is Fr. Tim Mockaitis' humble effort to evangelize: Reflections on Scripture and Saints alive in our Catholic life.

feeds.title: Father MDs Kitchen Table
feeds.description: Father MD is sharing the Good News from his kitchen table! View his Homilies, interviews, prayers, news, Rosaries, Stations of the Cross and more on his website.

feeds.title: Fr Jack SJ MD
feeds.description: Read Sunday Homilies by Fr Jack SJ MD. He is a Jesuit priest of the New England Province of the Society of Jesus who entered rather late in life after practicing medicine and psychiatry for 22 years.

feeds.title: Ignatian Spirituality
feeds.description: John Predmore, S.J., is a USA East Province Jesuit and was the pastor of Jordan's English language parish. He teaches art & directs BC High's adult spiritual formation programs. Ignatian Spirituality serves the contemporary world as people strive to develop a friendship with God.

feeds.title: Fr. Victor Brown\'s Catholic Daily Message
feeds.description: Here you can read Fr. Victor Brown's daily message related to Catholic feasts and other events related to the Catholic Church. He is currently in Residence at Holy Rosary Priory, Houston.

feeds.title: On This Rock
feeds.description: View the blog posts and Homilies by Father John Hollowell on his blog called On This Rock.

feeds.title: southern orders
feeds.description: The southern orders is a liturgical blog by Fr. Allan J. McDonald. He is a retired priest of the Diocese of Savannah ordained in 1980 at the Cathedral of Saint John the Baptist. He currently resides at Hilton Head Island, South Carolina.

feeds.title: This Present Time
feeds.description: Read the blog by Father Andrew Hart called This Present Time. Father Andrew is a Catholic priest in Arkansas. He began this blog when he lived and studied in Rome as a seminarian.

feeds.title: Lux Vera
feeds.description: Lux Vera is a blog by Fr. David Thoroughgood. On his blog, you can read the Sunday Sermons and find the Mass schedule. He is a priest of the Adelaide archdiocese and celebrates the Latin Mass according to the 2007 document Summorum Pontificum.

feeds.title: Reflections and Ruminations
feeds.description: This is a blog by Father Luke Fong. He is an Assistant Priest in the Church of the Immaculate Heart of Mary in Singapore. After receiving a precious and life-saving stem cell transplant for his leukemia in 2013, Fr. Luke has since gained enough strength and returned to active ministry with a grateful heart.

feeds.title: A Monk's Chronicle
feeds.description: A Monk's Chronicle is a blog by Fr. Eric Hollas, OSB. Fr. Eric Hollas is a monk and priest of Saint John's Abbey in Collegeville. Since 1980 he has been a member of the faculty of the School of Theology and Department of Theology at Saint John's University in Minnesota.

feeds.title: Fr. Bill's Personal Pages Blog
feeds.description: Ruminations of a geek priest are Fr. Bill's personal pages where he writes letters addressing his parishioners. He was ordained in 2000 and is a pastor at Holy Trinity Parish in Beaverton. Since ordination, he has been actively involved in new media as a avenue to spread the Good News of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Father Andrew Vogel's Blog
feeds.description: View the latest posts on Father Andrew Vogel's blog where he shares his Homilies and other interests. He is a Catholic Priest for the Diocese of Winona.

feeds.title: fatherflader Blog
feeds.description: The fatherflader blog is where you will find meditations and mutterings from a Catholic priest. Who is the Father Flader who hosts this blog? I am Fr John Flader, born in Wisconsin and studied chemistry at Harvard University. I studied Theology in Rome and was ordained a priest of Opus Dei in Spain, in 1967. Now I am chaplain of Tangara School for girls in Sydney.

feeds.title: Sailing
feeds.description: Sailing is a blog by Father Roy Cimagala. Read the blog to learn about God and Christianity. The blog is being maintained by the CBCP Media Office.

feeds.title: Rev.FICO
feeds.description: Rev.FICO gives daily reflections on spirituality and Theology. Rev.FICO is a Roman Catholic Priest of the Archdiocese of Los Angeles and an American gospel artist with a mission to help everyone and strive to attain perfection in god.

feeds.title: The Hermeneutic of Continuity
feeds.description: Fr. Tim Finigan explores doctrine, liturgy, morals, the Churchs place in society, and other though-provoking topics through his blog The Hermeneutic of Continuity.

feeds.title: Bridges and Tangents
feeds.description: Fr. Stephen Wang is a Catholic priest in the Diocese of Westminster, London. This blog explores the landscape of arts, science, religion, politics, and philosophy.

feeds.title: Bishop Daniel R. Jenky, CSC
feeds.description: Bishop Daniel R. Jenky is Serving as Bishop of Peoria since 2012. He writes about serving the community, the Holy Spirit, and other insights on the Church.

feeds.title: Our Blessed Mother's Children
feeds.description: The blog is dedicated to Our Lady of Medjugorje. You will find various Novenas and prayers on the website. The author of the website is Fr. Neil Buchlein, Pastor at St. Mary Queen of Heaven.

feeds.title: Cardinal Roger Mahony Blogs L.A
feeds.description: Cardinal Roger Mahony Blogs L.A. is the official blog of the Archbishop Emeritus of Los Angeles. Personal reflections and experiences from the Archbishop Emeritus of Los Angeles.

feeds.title: The AX
feeds.description: Welcome to 'The Ax.' I am Fr. Tom Provenzano, a Salesian of Don Bosco and presently enrolled in the STL program at The Catholic University of America, in Washington, DC. Here I try to give a Catholic perspective on pop culture, current events and whatever else strikes me at the moment. Plus I post or link to other Catholic videos and sites that I hope you find beneficial.

feeds.title: The Canon's Stall
feeds.description: Hello, I am Canon Matthew Jones, a parish priest in north Cardiff. Born and bred in the city, I am also involved in other areas of church life, such as the National Tribunal for Wales, where I am currently Judicial Vicar. I write on local parish news, the election of Pope Francis, and the celebration of Easter.

feeds.title: Fr. Dennis at the Movies
feeds.description: Reviews of current films written by Fr. Dennis Zdenek Kriz, OSM of St. Philip Benizi Parish, Fullerton. Fr. Dennis is a Catholic priest who's loved movies all his life, enjoys talking/writing about them and picking apart their themes.

feeds.title: Gloria Olivae
feeds.description: This blog by Gloria Olivae promotes the messages of Pope Benedict XVI and seeks to draw upon small monastic Benedictine communities.

feeds.title: ADAM'S ALE
feeds.description: Fr. Adam Valencheck writes about a day in the life of a priest, interesting quotes, and thoughts for consideration.

feeds.title: Catholic Collar And Tie
feeds.description: Catholic Collar And Tie is a blog written by the man in the street for the man in the street. This blog offers thoughts and reflections on usually Catholic issues, such as Church law, reform, and the future of Pope Francis, from Fr. Gary Dickson.

feeds.title: Father Acervo's Corner
feeds.description: I am a Roman Catholic priest currently serving in the Archdiocese of Detroit as pastor at St. Edward on-the-Lake Catholic Church in Lakeport, MI. I hope and pray that what you find here may always be faithful to the message of the Gospel and that it may serve you to grow in your love for the Most Holy Trinity.

feeds.title: Father Richmond
feeds.description: Fr. Richmond Dzekoe posts his Reflections to the Sunday readings on his blog. He also adds the Bible verses for the readings' reference.

feeds.title: Father Dylan James
feeds.description: Father Dylan James blogs about Sermons, Talks, Lectures, and more. He is a Catholic Priest and a dual American-British citizen.

feeds.title: Father Mark White Blog
feeds.description: Father Mark White's blog features his podcast on Catholic teachings. He also talks about his experience as a survivor of sexual abuse and other church scandals. He is a priest of the diocese of Richmond, Virginia. He started his blog to build a full account of Cdl. McCarrick's crimes and who covered them up.

feeds.title: Aspiepriest
feeds.description: I am a Roman Catholic Priest with Asperger's Syndrome ponders the Catholic Faith and human nature. I am writing this blog for other autistic readers, for anyone who has an autistic friend, and for scholars whose work touches on human nature.

feeds.title: Journey Thoughts, revisited
feeds.description: This blog is a place for Reflections of a retired priest. I am Father Len Stoviak and I was ordained a Catholic priest for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Greensburg in 1973. The purpose of this blog is to simply 'share my thoughts along the journey'. These reflections may be scriptural, spiritual theological or social, touching upon parish life and the greater reality that those experiences reflect.

feeds.title: Fr. Rick Martignetti, OFM
feeds.description: Fr. Rick Martignetti is a Franciscan Friar sharing faith with youth and young adults. He is a Catholic priest and a member of the Order of Friars Minor, a brotherhood started by St. Francis of Assisi in 1209. Fr. Rick is part of a Province of Friars particularly consecrated to the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

feeds.title: John Predmore: To the Frontiers - Ignatian Artists, Poets, Writers, and Seekers
feeds.description: John Predmore is a Jesuit priest who has an avocation of binding art and creativity to spirituality. He has a studio in Boston and gives retreats and spiritual direction using creative techniques to make a person's Ignatian prayer particular and unique.

feeds.title: Homilies of Father Paul Yi
feeds.description: On this blog, you can read Homilies written by Father Paul Yi. You can also find categories like Bible Study, Lives of the Saints, and more.

feeds.title: Fr. Chuck's Blog
feeds.description: Read the Homilies, Columns and More by Rev. Charles R. Kullmann, CSP. He is a Pastor of St. Austin Catholic Parish, Diocese of Austin.

feeds.title: Humility Rules
feeds.description: A weekly commentary on the Rule of Saint Benedict - for teenagers. The author, Father J. Augustine Wetta is a monk of Saint Louis Abbey, Missouri, where he teaches high school and coaches rugby.

feeds.title: Gateshead Revisited
feeds.description: The life and times of Fr Michael Brown, the most recent parish priest of St Joseph`s and St Wilfrid`s, Gateshead who is also chaplain to the North of England for the Latin Mass Society.

feeds.title: Saska Priest Blog
feeds.description: Read the news and media from Fr. Darryl Millette on his blog. This is the ministry blog and podcast site for Fr. Darryl Millette of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Saskatoon.

feeds.title: A Shepherd's Post
feeds.description: A Priest of the Archdiocese of Boston sharing some homilies, thoughts on the spiritual life and evangelization, and the joy of priesthood. Fr. David Barnes was ordained a priest of the Archdiocese of Boston in 1997 and is a Spiritual Director at St. John's Seminary in Boston.

feeds.title: Father Anne Blog
feeds.description: Father Anne's blog is about a Roman Catholic priest bringing about gender equality in the Roman Catholic Church. Father Anne was ordained on October 16, 2021 in Albuquerque through the Association of Roman Catholic Women Priests and is now an independent Roman Catholic priest.

feeds.title: God's Word to Us
feeds.description: God's Word to Us is a blog written by Fr. Dominic Danh Tran, SDB. This blog intends to provide readers an opportunity to be nourished by the Word of God. It invites readers to read, reflect and pray the Gospel passage that they will hear during the upcoming Sunday's Liturgy.

feeds.title: Pauca Verba
feeds.description: Fr. Stephen Morris writes his thoughts and reflections on faith and Christianity in a blog called Pauca Verba, which means 'A few words'. He was ordained a priest in 1979 for the Diocese of Rockville Centre. Before seminary Fr. Stephen taught in New York City parochial schools.

feeds.title: Printed as Preached
feeds.description: The homily has special importance due to its eucharistic context: it surpasses all forms of catechesis as the supreme moment in the dialogue between God and his people which lead up to sacramental communion. Here you can read Homilies and blog posts by Father Cávana Wallace, Pastor of Saint Therese Parish.

feeds.title: Where the Rubber Hits the Road
feeds.description: Where the Rubber Hits the Road is a blog of Reflections from the pastoral ministry of an Evangelical Catholic Priest named Fr. Tim Moyle from Diocese of Pembroke.

feeds.title: RVA Priest Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest updates, news, and reflections from the Richmond seminarians. We are promoting vocations to the priesthood and religious life in the Catholic Diocese of Richmond.

feeds.title: Welcome from Matthew Fox Blog
feeds.description: Here you can read the blog posts by the Rev. Dr. Matthew Fox. Matthew Fox is a spiritual theologian, an Episcopal priest and an activist for gender justice and eco-justice.

feeds.title: Building on the Word
feeds.description: A Resource for Scripture, Culture, and Faith. Building on the Word is the personal website of Fr. George M. Smiga.

feeds.title: AtonementOnline
feeds.description: The diary of a priest, Fr. Christopher George Phillips, being random thoughts and various things of possible interest from the founding pastor (now retired) of Our Lady of the Atonement Church in San Antonio, Texas.

feeds.title: The Basilica Of Saint Mary Blog
feeds.description: The Pastor's Blog is written by Father Daniel Griffith, Pastor and Rector at The Basilica of Saint Mary, Hennepin Ave. The Basilica of Saint Mary is a community rooted in the gospel of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Feroz Fernandes Blog
feeds.description: Feroz Fernandes, a Catholic Missionary, identifies himself as an Uncommon Priest. Father Feroz loves adventure in the apostolate. As a pastor, he admire others priests, who despite their situation, keep their calling relevant. You can read Father Feroz's thoughts in his blogs.

feeds.title: Our Lady of the Presentation Catholic Church Blog
feeds.description: Get to know the thoughts of Fr. Tom of Our Lady of the Presentation Catholic Church. The mission of our Church is to share our gifts by providing opportunities for spiritual growth in worship, service, education and community activities.
